title: DC-area forecast: Still nice today despite the start of a warming trend
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Plenty of sun helps afternoon highs to the mid-80s. Humidity is still reasonable.

What’s next? Quite warm Thursday and Friday with increasing humidity. Scattered showers and a thunderstorm could come through late Thursday afternoon or evening.

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: They can't all be perfect 10s like yesterday, but today is perfectly nice even if several degrees warmer. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Wednesday): Mostly sunny with somewhat warmer highs heading for the mid-80s. Humidity is still pretty low, just not as gloriously low as Monday and Tuesday, with dew points near 60. A breeze comes from the south around 10 mph. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tonight: Partly cloudy as evening 70s drop back to overnight lows in the 60s. A light breeze from the south allows the humidity to creep just slightly higher. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Thursday): Partly sunny, another step warmer, and a touch more humid. Afternoon highs aim for the mid-80s to near 90 with dew points in the mid-60s. High pressure retreats enough for the chance of scattered showers and a storm in the late afternoon or evening. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Still the chance of scattered showers and a storm during the evening. Becoming quite muggy by evening or overnight with warmer lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

❤️ How to support Capital Weather

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

As of now, it looks like high pressure will push a cold front far enough to our south Friday and Saturday to limit rain chances to an isolated shower. Otherwise both days are partly sunny with Friday highs in the mid-80s and rather humid, and Saturday highs in the upper 70s to low 80s with somewhat lower humidity. Confidence: Low-Medium

Quickly trending more humid again Sunday as the front comes back north closer to us. That introduces the chance for scattered showers, maybe a thunderstorm, at some point during the afternoon or evening. Highs top out in the upper 70s to mid-80s. Confidence: Low

DC weather history for September 16

A rare DC tornado in 1888 caused localized damage, while later years brought flooding rains and tropical impacts—including a record 1976 deluge and the remnants of Hurricane Floyd in 1999.
